'''Giuseppe Novelli''' (born 27 February 1959) is an Italian geneticist and the [[President (education)|president]] of the [[University of Rome Tor Vergata]].

==Early life and career==
Born in  [[Rossano]] in the south of Italy, he graduated [[magna cum laude]] in [[genetics]] at the [[University of Urbino]] in 1981. In 1985 earned a [[Ph.D]] at [[Sapienza University of Rome]].<ref>{{Cite web | title=ANVUR | url=http://www.anvur.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=365&lang=it | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222175230/http://www.anvur.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=365&lang=it | access-date=2025-05-30 | archive-date=2014-02-22}}</ref>
In 1995 he was appointed professor of genetics at the [[University of Rome Tor Vergata]].

From 2003 he has also been an [[adjunct professor]] at [[Arkansas University]].

From 2008 to 2011 he was president of the Faculty of [[Medicine]] and Surgery at Tor Vergata. In 2013 he was elected [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of his university.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ilmessaggero.it/ROMA/CRONACA/tor_vergata_rettore_giuseppe_novelli_universit_amp_agrave/notizie/333617.shtml|title=Pagina non Trovata|access-date=2014-09-02|archive-date=2017-08-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170822180131/http://www.ilmessaggero.it/ROMA/CRONACA/tor_vergata_rettore_giuseppe_novelli_universit_amp_agrave/notizie/333617.shtml|url-status=dead}}</ref>
